annotations.title: Apply now (walk-in guide, form preview, or hand-off)

description: [Trip-Pups(트립펍스) — 외국인 축제 찾기·신청] One step toward joining an event, chosen by how the event takes sign-ups (signup_type). walk_in: tells the traveler no advance sign-up is needed and how to get there (nothing is recorded). web_form: mode=preview (default) shows exactly which fields of the organizer's form would be filled with the traveler's details; nothing is sent to the organizer and nothing is stored. naver_booking / phone_verify / paid_ticket / unknown: cannot be completed automatically. In mode=preview this tool only explains what a hand-off to a Trip-Pups team member would involve and stores nothing; to actually hand the request over, call request_application_help after the traveler agrees. In mode=preview apply_now never stores or sends anything, whatever the sign-up method. mode=submit is turned off on this server unless the operator enables it. consent must be true, meaning the traveler agreed to share these details for this sign-up. Privacy notice: https://trip-pups-mcp.pxh7yp.workers.dev/privacy

applicant.description: The traveler's details, exactly as they gave them

consent.description: Must be true: the traveler agreed to share these details for this sign-up

submit_consent.description: mode=submit only: true means the traveler read the organizer's form and consent text and agrees that we send it for them, in their own name and details
